the identification and characterization of the molecular events responsible for the regulation of the hepatic gene encoding for S-adenosy methionine synthetases, an enzyme involved in the methionine metabolism.
the identification of cis- and trans-acting elements that are involved in the hormonal control of hepatic Sadenosylmethione synthetase expression.
the molecular mechanisms involved in the regulation of the S-adenosylethionine synthetases by glucocorticoids.

the hepatic Sadenosylmethione synthetase gene is regulated by glucocorticoids at the transcriptional and posttranscriptional levels.

the glucocorticoid response of S-adenosymethionine synthetases is mediated by the induction of mRNA levels.
